source.stem:
Magnesium nitride is formed when magnesium burns in air. Magnesium nitride is an ionic compound.

What is the formula of magnesium nitride?

packed_tags.subject: science
packed_tags.topic: States of matter, particles and water

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Strong repulsion between tightly packed particles holds a solid in a fixed shape and volume.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Tight packing alone fixes a solid's shape and volume; strong attractions are unnecessary.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: A solid's fixed shape and volume force its particles close together and make their attractions strong.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: A solid cannot change shape, even when hammered or broken.

intelligence.enrichment: In solids, particles are tightly packed and the interparticle attractions are very strong, so solids keep a definite shape and definite volume. tight packing and strong attraction between particles -> fixed shape and fixed volume The learner explains definite shape and volume of solids by tightly packed particles, very strong interparticle attractions, and fixed positions with only vibration. A solid keeps its shape only because its outside surface is hard.
